findings.message: Outcome guarantee or absolute claim; not allowed in dental advertising.
Chatbot residue left in the draft.

findings.quote: every implant we place comes with a lifetime guarantee
findings.why: A lifetime guarantee is a prohibited outcome promise under ADA advertising rules. It also contradicts the post's own statement that no dentist can predict how long a restoration will last, and the ficha lists no such guarantee.
findings.fix: Delete the guarantee claim and state only what the ficha supports, for example that Dr. Marsh sees implant patients.

findings.quote: I hope this helps! Let me know if you would like me to adjust the tone or add a section on costs.
findings.why: This is leftover AI assistant text addressed to the requester, not to readers.
findings.fix: Remove the whole sentence pair before publishing.

findings.why: I cannot verify that NIDCR publishes a page at this URL, and the slug looks invented, so it may be a fabricated or dead link.
findings.fix: Replace it with a verified NIDCR or ADA MouthHealthy implant page, or remove the citation.

findings.quote: most patients describe soreness afterward rather than sharp pain
findings.why: This is a checkable statement about patient experience with no source or clinic data behind it.
findings.fix: Cite a reputable source or soften it to "some soreness is common afterward; your dentist will explain what to expect."

findings.quote: a bridge is typically completed in fewer visits
findings.why: The comparison of treatment duration is general and has no supporting source.
findings.fix: Add a source, or phrase it as something to ask the dentist about timing.
